scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:core: cd packages/core && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:types
scripts.typecheck:packages: cd packages/http && bun run typecheck && cd ../http-otel && bun run typecheck && cd ../kafka && bun run typecheck && cd ../kafka-kafkajs && bun run typecheck && cd ../kafka-platformatic && bun run typecheck && cd ../otel && bun run typecheck && cd ../postgres && bun run typecheck && cd ../redis && bun run typecheck && cd ../topology && bun run typecheck && cd ../transform && bun run typecheck
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/core && bun run build && cd ../http && bun run build && cd ../http-otel && bun run build && cd ../kafka && bun run build && cd ../kafka-kafkajs && bun run build && cd ../kafka-platformatic && bun run build && cd ../otel && bun run build && cd ../postgres && bun run build && cd ../redis && bun run build && cd ../topology && bun run build && cd ../transform && bun run build
scripts.build:swc: rustup target add wasm32-wasip1 && cd crates/swc-plugin-perfect && cargo build --locked --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && mkdir -p ../../packages/swc-plugin/dist && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/swc_plugin_perfect.wasm ../../packages/swc-plugin/dist/plugin.wasm
scripts.release:dry: (cd packages/core && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/http && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/http-otel && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/kafka && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/kafka-kafkajs && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/kafka-platformatic && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/otel && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/postgres && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/redis && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/topology && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/transform && bun pm pack --dry-run) && (cd packages/swc-plugin && bun pm pack --dry-run)
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.ci: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:packages && bun run smoke:packages && bun run documentation:check && bun run perf:gate
scripts.test:integration: (cd packages/integration && bun test) && (cd packages/redis && bun test) && (cd packages/postgres && bun test)
